issue_context.title: cannot filter empty object array & not implemented for dtype Object("object")
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example
```python
import datetime as dt
import polars as pl
import pandas as pd


t = dt.datetime(2023, 5, 1, 10, 11)
time_start = dt.datetime(2023, 5, 1, 10, 10)
time_end = None
o = True
my_list = ['13285747','13308629']

data = {
    'a': ['1E','2E', '3E', '4E', '5E'],
    'b': [dt.datetime(2023,5,1,7), dt.datetime(2023,5,1,7,7,8), dt.datetime(2023,5,1,7,7,11), dt.datetime(2023,5,1,3,40,51), dt.datetime(2023,5,1,10,6,18)],
    'c': [False, False, False, True, True],
    'd': ['13285747', '13295270', '13302945', '13308629', '13312416' ],
    'e': ['13285747', '13295270', None, '13308629', '13312416' ],
    
}

lazy = pl.LazyFrame(data)
lazy = lazy.with_columns(pl.col('b').dt.timestamp(time_unit='us').alias("timestamp_us"))
lazy = lazy.with_columns(
            pl.col('a').apply(
            lambda p: bytearray(p, 'utf-8')*2, skip_nulls=False).alias("proto").cast(pl.Object))
df = lazy.filter(pl.col('timestamp_us') < t)


df = df.filter(pl.col("timestamp_us") >= time_start) if time_start is not None else df


df = df.filter(pl.col("timestamp_us") <= time_end) if time_end is not None else df

df = df.filter(pl.col("c") == o) if o is not None else df

df = df.filter(pl.col("d").is_in(my_list) | 
            pl.col("e").is_in(my_list)
            ) if my_list is not None else df

df.collect(no_optimization=True)

```

### Issue description

It should return empty dataframe, neglecting the filters. With df.collect() output is PanicException: not implemented for dtype Object("object"). 



### Expected behavior

Return empty dataframe, and to work the same with and without optimization.

review_comments:
It seems that for other types, if it is empty, we will get an empty `ChunkedArray`. But the `ObjectChunked` is exception, it will threw an error. We'd better maintain consistent behavior. 

This `check_filter_len ` ensure that if `self` is `empty` then `filter` must also be `empty`, so that we can get an `empty` filtered chunked.  I can't think of any reason to support the unequal length between `self` and `filter`(except for broadcasting). If it does exist, special branch may be needed for this empty cases.

> I can't think of any reason to support the unequal length between self and filter(except for broadcasting).

Me neither.
Not sure why we only `check_filter_len` for `non-nested` type.
